title: Sandcastle Hub Template Metadata
description: Schema for validating template entries in the Sandcastle Community Hub registry

description.description: Short description of what the template does

author_url.description: URL to the author's profile (e.g. GitHub)

models_used.description: List of model short names used in steps (e.g. sonnet, haiku)

tools_used.description: List of tool connector names used (e.g. salesforce, slack)

step_count.description: Number of steps in the workflow

license.description: License for the template (defaults to MIT)

estimated_cost_per_run.description: Estimated cost in USD per workflow execution based on model pricing

remix_count.description: Number of community remixes (forks) of this template

forked_from.description: Slug of the original template this was remixed from (null if original)

source.description: Whether this is a built-in or community-contributed template

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the workflow YAML content for integrity verification
